Some guests ride pedal-assist bikes, and others ride ordinary bikes. The guide stops so riders can take photographs along the way. People stay with the bikes for the riding portion of the booking.

facts.description: Enjoy the best of Los Angeles with this two hour guided eBike tour that begins in Santa Monica near the famous Santa Monica Pier! You must be at least 16 to ride our pedal assist ebikes. There will be guests riding standard, non-electric bikes on this tour. Take in the ocean breezes, visit the historic Venice Canals, ride through Marina del Rey, take pictures with the Art Walls, and explore Muscle Beach. You'll be able to visit all of the main highlights that the area has to offer, while learning fun facts, seeing beautiful views, and more! This guided tour takes about 3 hours, including various stops near essential attractions while our guides provide in-depth narration and stop for photo opportunities at famous sights and hidden gems throughout the tour. For safety reasons, we are unable to attach tag-a-longs and trailers to ebikes. Guests must be 16+ to ride an eBike!

facts.description: Duration 2-4 Hour Options! About Enjoy one of our regularly scheduled bike tours in a more intimate setting or work with us to customize your own tour. This is a perfect choice for families, VIPs, or anyone looking for a more personal experience on Santa Monica's top rated bike tour! Enjoy the best of Los Angeles with this two hour guided bike tour that begins in Santa Monica near the famous Santa Monica Pier! Take in the ocean breezes, visit the historic Venice Canals, ride through Marina del Rey, take pictures with the Art Walls, and explore Muscle Beach. The sunny California weather makes this tour a fun and beautiful experience for culture enthusiasts and history buffs. Choose between 2 Hours, 3 Hours, and 4 Hours four your private ride, as well as the time that you would like to go. Tips: Dress appropriately for the weather and don't forget your camera!
facts.detailsText: PICK UP LOCATION : Please look closely at the location that you picked in the booking. 1431 Ocean Ave Santa Monica, CA 90401 Please plan to arrive 15 minutes early as the tour does leave on time.
